english.meaning: a man dressed in black, also the title of the film Men in Black

exampleSentences.english: The man in black? The one who chased him, the one who went with him, or the one they found at the end?
exampleSentences.traditional: 黑衣人？你係指追殺，唔係，即係跟埋佢一齊去嗰個，定係最後發現嗰個先？
